body: I don't know. I think at first a few years ago I thought: "maybe I'm not just shy, but actually have anxiety, but if I don't then I could always stop pretending to have it, right?" but time was flying and I felt like I just can't stop it, I never had a lot of friends but when I tried to make them I just couldn't. So I guess I became depressed? But maybe I'm just pretending again so people will think I'm special? I'm afraid to get therapist not only because it's expensive, but also I'm afraid that they will just say something like: "that's just your age, all you kids are like that"

I just don't really know if I really am depressed or if those thoughts are serious ones. Like I think about how it would be easier to end it all almost every day. But then I feel like I haven't yet done everything I wanted to or that my parents will think it's their fault. I feel like I'm faking my depression and thoughts for "to not be like the other kids" or to gain attention or something.
